start_frame: The sh060 close continued: her hand still flat on her head, waiting — and nothing happening at all.
end_frame: The same frame after the two full seconds of flat disappointment: she has set to work and finished the whole cake, briskly and without ceremony, brushing the crumbs off her pinafore.
constraint_honoured: 'The two-second hold on the flat, cheated face is the joke and is NOT cut into.'
movement_note: The joke is that nothing happens, so nothing may happen in the camera either; the same set-up as sh060 keeps the two shots reading as one continuous beat.
